summary: Review failed: the cleanup commit still leaves deleted-script references in Python code, and the handoff does not cover the full VAL-FC-005 test requirement.

blockingIssues.description: VAL-FC-004 is not satisfied because deleted file references remain in functional Python code after the cleanup. `eval_sim_learning_suite.py` still shells out to deleted scripts, and `test_muse_semantic_training_lab.py` still imports a deleted script path.
blockingIssues.evidence: validation-contract.md:17-19 requires zero broken references; part64/scripts/eval_sim_learning_suite.py:431 references `scripts/muse_semantic_training_lab.py`, part64/scripts/eval_sim_learning_suite.py:497 references `scripts/bench_muse_song_lab.py`, and part64/code/tests/test_muse_semantic_training_lab.py:10 references `scripts/muse_semantic_training_lab.py`.

blockingIssues.description: VAL-FC-005 is not fully satisfied by the recorded implementation evidence. The contract requires `test_myth_bridge` to keep passing, but the handoff only documents vitest, `test_world_life`, and `test_sonify_determinism`.
blockingIssues.evidence: validation-contract.md:21-23 requires vitest plus `test_world_life`, `test_myth_bridge`, and `test_sonify_determinism`; the handoff records only `cd part64/frontend && npx vitest run --exclude 'e2e/**'`, `cd part64 && python3 -m code.tests.test_world_life`, and `cd part64 && python3 -m code.tests.test_sonify_determinism` (handoff JSON lines 16-27, 59), and no `test_myth_bridge` entry appears in the handoff or transcript search.

sharedStateObservations.description: The worker followed the feature text and omitted `test_myth_bridge`, even though VAL-FC-005 requires it. The refactor workflow should explicitly tell workers to reconcile feature verification steps with the validation contract before handoff.
sharedStateObservations.why: This would prevent future handoffs from claiming assertion coverage when a required suite was never run or documented.

sharedStateObservations.description: The current guidance around excluding `.opencode/` is too broad. The reviewed handoff suggests excluding `.opencode/` from dead-reference searches, but `.opencode/skills/simulation-ops/SKILL.md:63` still points at deleted `part64/SIMULATION_WORKFLOW.md`.
sharedStateObservations.why: Shared guidance should distinguish generated/archive content from maintained skill files so stale repo references are not left behind.
